narrationTexts: Confirms the bug: `orderTotal` in [src/pricing.js:39-43](src/pricing.js:39) taxes the pre-discount `cents` instead of the discounted amount.
finalText:
**Suite is green: 625 passing, 0 failing.**

The bug was in `orderTotal` at [src/pricing.js:39](src/pricing.js:39). It taxed the original `cents` instead of the discounted amount, so any row with both a discount and a tax rate came out wrong. Fixed by applying tax to `discounted` instead.

No further action needed.
